remarks: Welcome to this totally renovated 3-bedroom, 2-bath home in Greenwich, offering the perfect blend of style, comfort, and convenience. Enjoy hardwood floors and a stunning eat-in kitchen featuring stainless steel appliances, a gas cooktop, and quartz countertops. A first-floor office provides ideal work-from-home space. The home also offers a finished basement for additional living space, plus a lower-level laundry area with a full-size washer and dryer. Outside, the fenced backyard is perfect for relaxing or entertaining. Additional highlights include an attached garage, plenty of parking, and a location just a short walk to Greenwich amenities and close to public transportation for an easy commute to NYC.
